props.title: The mother of the bride should get to sit down
props.text: Venue, catering, decoration, photographers and the priest's timings, handled by one team that stays until the last guest has gone home.

image.alt: A bride holding a bouquet in warm light
A long table set with glasses and flowers

props.heading: One planner on the phone from the first visit to the bidaai
props.body: Nepali weddings run over several days, with a lot of hands. We draw up a plan for each ceremony (swayambar, mehendi, bratabandha or pasni if it falls in the same week), assign a person to each, and give your family one number to call.

props.heading: How the last three months go

items.title: Venue and date locked
items.text: We visit two or three venues with you, and check the muhurat with your pandit before paying an advance.

items.title: Menu tasting
items.text: Catering tasting for the family, including a plate for those who eat no onion or garlic.

items.title: Decoration and photos
items.text: Mock-up of the stage and mandap. Photographers walk the venue in the same light as the ceremony.

items.title: Run sheet to every family member
items.text: A one-page plan in Nepali, with names and phone numbers for each ceremony.

props.title: Which date are you thinking about?
props.text: Tell us the date and the number of guests. We will say honestly whether we can do it well.

props.heading: Three ways to work with us
props.intro: Venue, food and decoration are billed at cost, with no markup. Our fee covers planning and people.

items.q: Do you work with our own pandit?
items.a: Always. We only ask for the muhurat and the timings for each ritual.

items.q: Can you plan outside the valley?
items.a: Yes, Pokhara and Chitwan. Travel and rooms for the team are added at cost.

items.q: How much advance do we pay?
items.a: Rs 25,000 to hold the date, taken from the fee.

pages.seoDescription: Ask whether we are free on your wedding date. Tell us the date, the guest count and the venue you have in mind.

props.heading: Check a date
props.text: Give us the date you have in mind and the rough number of guests. We reply within a day, and we say honestly if the date is taken.
